review_scope: Independent legal-domain IC summary numerical audit, no developer fixtures

baseline_control.input: six identical positive or negative binary64 0.7 IC values
baseline_control.expected: mean is exactly the input binary64 value, sample std=0, ICIR=NaN

WR-08.independent_oracle: Exact Fraction moments of actual finite binary64 IC inputs; sample ddof=1; 180-significant-digit Decimal square root and mean/std ratio
positive_coverage: Constant nonperfect positive and negative IC at 2,3,6,9,17,31,252 days; exact zero sample std and undefined ICIR
0/1 valid days, NaN/inf filtering, original valid/total/common-observation count behavior
Representable real adjacent-ULP and tiny nonzero standard deviations preserved without a zero threshold
Smallest subnormal and tiny scales with finite representable ICIR despite rounded public means/std
Legal IC-domain translations, permutations, strong mean cancellation and independent exact-input expectations
480 deterministic random general, near-constant and tiny-scale cases
Independent daily_rank_ic to summarize_ic nonperfect constant 23/35 rank pattern
scope_limitations: Shifted mean reconstruction is not guaranteed correctly rounded under strong cancellation, and can lose relative accuracy near zero
This is disclosed as an ordinary absolute-rounding limitation, not misreported as a large ICIR or phantom near-zero variance defect
No platform, financial data or real performance certification

tolerances.sample_std_normal: 32*eps relative; subnormal public-output quantization permits 2 ULP
tolerances.positive_std_guard: Every correctly rounded representable positive oracle std must remain strictly positive
tolerances.ICIR_near_constant_large: 32*eps relative, not a broad absolute allowance
tolerances.ICIR_near_zero: 32*eps absolute; prevents invalid relative-error alarms for highly cancelled means

cancellation_limitation.reason: Absolute error remains below a single eps times the input scale, while variance is of ordinary size. Baseline/candidate permutation comparisons preserved separately. No preregistered downstream sign-threshold error was demonstrated.

first_run.cause: Audit diagnostic EPS*subnormal scale underflowed to zero in an error-normalization denominator; all reached production mathematical assertions passed.

reviewer_harness_history.final_correction: Changed diagnostic to (error/scale)/eps; strengthened positive representable std assertion; original oracle expectations and tolerance values preserved. First script/log/results and complete diff retained.

strict_relative_experiment.criterion: Exploratory 32eps pure relative bound for every nonzero ICIR, including small strongly cancelled ratios
strict_relative_experiment.conclusion: Precision limitation retained, not a new blocking source defect: observed absolute differences remain ordinary input-scale rounding; applying a pure relative metric to small cancelled means overstates significance.
strict_relative_experiment.history_integrity: Experiment script/results/output and first difference preserved in relative_tolerance_*; not classified as final production assertion failures and not silently substituted for the initial tolerance policy.
